Its small metal grip/finial is INSIDE his closed fingers and palm: conceal that fitting behind his gripping hand; no extra metal tab crossing outside the fingers, no impossible ring/blade/plate sticking out, no duplicated finial. The thumb overlaps the fingers naturally. Clear anatomically plausible grip with fingers wrapping around the rod.
3. Reframe/crop the artwork as a finished upper-body cinematic 16:9 shot of the men and scroll, so their bodies and cloaks continue cleanly beyond the bottom image boundary. Remove the unfinished lower-body region and dark empty foreground strip altogether. Both heads, all gripping hands, and the full scroll must remain visible. Do not add legs. Keep a bit of throne-room environment above/between them. No visible floating cut-off torso edges, no placeholder haze. Finished composition.
Keep the natural contours and soft cartoon shading. No photorealism, no faceted polygons, no text/UI/watermarks.

Precise prop/anatomy correction to this image. Preserve the exact composition, cartoon shading, characters, faces hidden by eye shadows, background, framing, blue glow.
The scroll has ONLY TWO ROLLER RODS: one along its LEFT vertical edge and one along its RIGHT vertical edge. No third horizontal rod at bottom, no rigid frame, no rolled parchment across the bottom.
Draw the scroll as a SINGLE broad FLAT flexible parchment sheet stretched between the two side rods, gently curving at its edges. Its bottom edge is thin parchment, NOT a horizontal cylinder.
The blue man's LOWER hand encloses the LOWER END OF THE LEFT VERTICAL ROD in a tight believable fist. The gold rod-end hardware is entirely INSIDE his closed fingers: no gold knob extending below that fist, no silver or gold collar extending sideways towards center from that fist. The rod is visible ABOVE the hand, ending INSIDE the hand; hide the terminal behind the fingers.
The red man's LOWER hand similarly grips the lower end of the right rod; hardware hidden inside fingers. The upper hands hold upper portions of these same two side rods.
Keep all faces/hands and the whole scroll within the picture, torsos continue to bottom edge. Do not otherwise redesign the scene.

Recolor the RIGHT man's red/burgundy cloak and red cloth clothing to rich muted ROYAL PURPLE. Recolor the right-side RED heraldic banners/flags in the background to the SAME purple family.
